title: Director of Manufacturing Process Engineering [84687]
text:
Our client is seeking a Director of Manufacturing Process Engineering for an on-site leadership opportunity. This role establishes effective, repeatable manufacturing processes for switchboard and switchgear products.

**Director of Manufacturing Process Engineering Responsibilities:**

* Develop, document, and enhance manufacturing methods, production routings, work instructions, and facility layouts.
* Review and approve process designs, PFMEAs, and control plans while maintaining rigorous engineering standards.
* Lead, coach, and develop manufacturing engineers and technicians in process engineering and structured improvement methods.
* Manage team staffing, priorities, performance, capital planning, tooling investments, and related budgets.
* Collaborate with Product Engineering, Quality, Production, Planning, and other functions to support manufacturability, quality, new product introduction, and continuous improvement.

**Director of Manufacturing Process Engineering Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Industrial, or Mechanical Engineering.
* At least eight years of progressive process engineering or closely related experience with substantial hands-on process development.
* Demonstrated capability with SolidWorks, manufacturing documentation, routings, process controls, PFMEA, control plans, SPC, and process capability.
* Experience leading and managing manufacturing engineering teams, including hiring, development, mentoring, and performance oversight.
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, continuous improvement, applicable UL 891, NEC, and ANSI standards, plus experience planning capital and tooling investments.

If you meet the qualifications and are excited about this opportunity, apply today! Our team will connect with you to discuss next steps, support you through the interview process, and advocate for your success.

degree.text: Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Industrial, or Mechanical Engineering.
